card.name: Resuming or stopping drug until a condition
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name or dosing word in instructions to interrupt, resume, restart or taper a drug. A condition for resuming (until, when, after, upon) usually comes next.

modes.label: Resume or restart drug name
modes.description: End of a brand name right after resume, restart or reinitiate, before the dose and the condition for resuming.
modes.example: Restart TIBSO<<VO>> at 500 mg once daily

modes.label: Taper or titrate wording
modes.description: Last word of a drug or frequency phrase in taper, discontinue or increase instructions, before a when or after clause.
modes.example: Taper corticosteroids and hydroxyure<<a>> after resolution of symptoms.

card.writes: It favors words meaning until or once (待, 直到, until, 一旦), pushing the text toward a condition that must be met.
card.plain: It fires in dose-adjustment instructions where a drug is held, resumed or tapered, just before the condition that decides when.
